statement: Drawing geometry only. Every shape is taken from a processed Stage 2 artefact and simplified for display; no figure is computed from it.

checks.name: The dissolved national outline is one closed ring
Every district of the source boundaries is drawn
Every damage point lies within the national outline’s extent
Shaking bands are ordered by intensity
The drawn damage grid holds every damage point
The drawn population blocks sum to the high-shaking, high-density figure the exposure analysis reports
The summary’s observation counts equal those the infrastructure analysis worked from
The drawn roads are a subset of the routed network
checks.detail: 9814 major and 5610 minor edges drawn of 62583 routed

simplification.method: Douglas–Peucker on a local equirectangular projection
simplification.note: For drawing only. Areas, counts and memberships are never computed from these shapes.

strongestShaking.basis: districts whose highest modelled contour is the highest contour the ShakeMap publishes

nepal.basis: centre of the national outline’s extent

damageCentre.basis: centre of the UNOSAT observations’ extent

shakeCentre.basis: midpoint of the epicentre and Kathmandu

accessCentre.basis: centre of the health-access analysis envelope

population.note: People-weighted centre of each 6 × 6 block of WorldPop 2015 1 km cells; blocks under 50 people are not drawn.
